trap.label: make + to
trap.wrong: It makes them to feel tired.
trap.why: Em português “faz com que se sintam” usa infinitivo ou subjuntivo. Em inglês, make + objeto + verbo base (sem to); só na passiva o to volta: be made to.

fix.wrong: The film made us to cry.

fix.right: They were made to work late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva na passiva: “The boss made them work late.”
rewrite.answer: They were made to work late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com make: “Music causes me to relax.”
Reescreva com adjetivo: “The news causes everyone to be happier.”
